name: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Trials after Justice
source:
The game is set after Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Justice for All.

Ep. 1: Checkmate and Turnabout: The basic tutorial trial, for the game. Maya, is the replacement attorney for Phoenix. As he unfortunately slept in and will be late to the court house, Maya is to defend a painter, who is accused of strangling someone whom he was painting.

Ep. 2: High School Turnabout: Phoenix is asked to represent a custodian by a fellow employee. The custodian is accused of stabbing a student. Along the way, he faces a new prosecutor, ex-Navy Lieutenant Hawk, who doesn’t approve of the way Phoenix has handled some of his cases.

Ep 3: Turnabout Daredevil's: Dragged to a stadium event by Maya and Pearl, Phoenix takes the case of a stunt driver, who is accused of robbing a bank and hitting and killing a pedestrian with their vehicle, all while unveiling a secret plot against the defendant. Along the way, Phoenix discovers a little more of Hawk's past, and finds out his true character.

Ep 4: Turnabout Legends: Phoenix and Maya are invited to a celebratory dinner at a Navy base. But murder and mayhem is the only thing on the dinner menu. Gumshoe is accused of murdering a Navy Captain, leaving it up Phoenix to defend the helpless Detective. In an epic trial, the truth must be uncovered and a past trial revealing Luis Hawk's secret will be discovered. But with a case with so many unanswered questions Phoenix will need his friends to help him find the truth of this dark case. 


[From [url=http://forums.court-records.net/viewtopic.php?f=36&t=12389]Court-Records[/url]]
translation:
本作的故事发生在《逆转裁判2》之后。

第1话《将杀的逆转》：本作的基础教学法庭。成步堂龙一不巧睡过了头，无法按时赶到法院，于是绫里真宵代替他担任辩护律师，为一名画家辩护。该画家被控勒死了自己正在描绘的对象。

第2话《校园逆转》：一名员工请成步堂为自己的同事辩护。被告是一名校工，遭到刺伤学生的指控。案件审理期间，成步堂遇见了新任检察官、前海军中尉霍克；霍克对成步堂过去处理部分案件的方式颇有不满。

第3话《特技车手的逆转》：成步堂被真宵和春美拉去参加体育场活动，随后接手了一名特技车手的案件。此人被控抢劫银行，并驾车撞死一名行人；与此同时，一场针对被告的秘密阴谋也逐渐暴露。调查途中，成步堂进一步了解了霍克的过去，并发现了他的真实为人。

第4话《传说的逆转》：成步堂和真宵受邀前往一座海军基地参加庆功晚宴，迎接他们的却只有谋杀与混乱。糸锯圭介被控杀害一名海军上校，成步堂必须为这位无助的刑警辩护。在这场波澜壮阔的审判中，真相必须得到揭露，而一桩过去的审判也将揭开路易斯·霍克的秘密。案件中仍有太多问题没有答案，成步堂需要朋友们的帮助，才能查明这起黑暗案件的真相。

[摘自[url=http://forums.court-records.net/viewtopic.php?f=36&t=12389]Court-Records[/url]]
